note: How a unit died: who did it, with what, and how long it stays down.

bits.name: zombie
bits.note: Set to leave the champion standing in a zombie state rather than dead: no death animation and no death screen.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of death this is.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with it, or zero where nothing is.

fields.name: damageType
fields.note: The sort of damage that finished it.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long the unit stays down, in seconds.
